method: Two fresh content reviewers independently graded disjoint halves using frozen facts, source-only texts, the preregistered protocol and unscored actual answers. A third reviewer independently audited all cited answers and unknown facts. No code/FAQ or desired score shown to graders.
primary_metric: Full semantic answer against predeclared minimum facts, with supporting citations for supported questions. Partial/fail subdivisions are descriptive; both count as not full. Safe generic refusal is not automatically a useful answer.

false_knowledge_absence_assertions.note: The requested facts exist in the source articles, while the answer says there is no confirmed answer in the base. Distinct from invented policy values.

interpretation_limits: Synthetic source-only agents, not real employees. Same source topics/facts across sets are expected.
No expected FAQ card IDs were used; full meaning was reviewed by agents, with possible evaluator subjectivity.
This set is now known and future runs on it are regression checks.
Do not compare this strict completeness score directly with old card/mode-only scores.
